name: Apollo Global Management, Inc.
monetization: Alternative asset manager and private-credit giant; monetizes AI by lending against it — GPU-collateralized SPV debt (xAI), margin lending against OpenAI equity (SoftBank syndicate), and Nvidia's compute-collateralized financing coalition.
description_md: Apollo Global Management is one of the largest private-credit managers, with the Athene insurance balance sheet giving it long-duration appetite for investment-grade structured paper. In the AI cycle it has specialized in the newest collateral types: GPUs and unlisted AI equity.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: earn private-credit spreads secured by AI hardware and AI equity rather than corporate guarantees. Apollo co-leads (with Diameter Capital) up to ~$12.5B of GPU-backed debt in the ~$20B xAI SPV that buys Nvidia chips and leases them to xAI for Colossus 2; Apollo Global Funding is in the syndicate for SoftBank's $10B margin loan collateralized by its OpenAI stake (Aug 2026); and Apollo is a founding member of Nvidia's >$500B compute-collateralized customer-financing coalition announced Aug 10, 2026 (subject to final agreements).
risk_notes_md: Classic wrong-way risk: the collateral (used GPUs, private OpenAI shares) is priced off the same AI demand cycle that would trigger borrower stress — the `collateralized_gpu_debt` pattern. Recovery values for large used-GPU fleets are untested at scale, and OpenAI equity collateral has no traded price. Insurance-account funding (Athene) means stress would propagate into policyholder-backed portfolios, the channel highlighted by BIS and Fed financial-stability work in 2026.

observations.notes: Up to $12.5B of GPU-backed debt within the ~$20B SPV ($7.5B equity anchored by Valor incl. ≤$2B Nvidia); five-year lease to xAI.
Total facility size; Apollo Global Funding LLC is one of five named lenders alongside Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Mizuho, and SMBC — Apollo's individual share undisclosed.

events.title: Reported co-lead of GPU-backed debt for xAI's ~$20B SPV
events.why_it_matters: One of the first landmark tests of GPUs as standalone loan collateral at scale, keeping ~$20B of compute financing off xAI's balance sheet.

events.title: Founding member of Nvidia's >$500B customer-financing coalition
events.why_it_matters: Extends Apollo's GPU-collateral lending model into a systemic framework for financing Nvidia's own customers.
